patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Hunter share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Hunter share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Bombora only if your buying job matches “Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact dat” rather than Hunter's shape. Choose Hunter only if your buying job matches “Domain email finder, verifier, and cold email sequences (All-in-one) — Free 50 credits; St” rather than Bombora's shape. Workflow advantage: Bombora leans lead-management; Hunter leans email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Hunter share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Bombora is Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact database; custom-quote packaging.; Hunter is Domain email finder, verifier, and cold email sequences (All-in-one) — Free 50 credits; Starter from $49/mo..
- Company-size focus: Bombora (mid-market, enterprise) vs Hunter (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Bombora-leaning lead-management vs Hunter-leaning email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Bombora — Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Hunter — Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database.

Limitations — Bombora: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Custom-quote only via speak-to-an-expert path; Hunter: Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database; Lead scoring is limited versus enterprise SI platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Bombora is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database · Hunter is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database · Avoid Bombora if you actually need Hunter's motion (Domain email finder, verifier, and cold email sequences (All-in-one) — Free 50 c)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
